description: **Software Engineer** in the Investment Portfolio Technology division (CCIBT, Commercial & Corporate Investment Banking).
achievements: Built **React** UI components from Figma designs, **.NET** APIs, and **Python** wrappers for external-service integrations in portfolio management applications handling **$400B+ in assets**.

Designed a new deployment architecture for the team's React client on **OpenShift**, replacing its .NET config wrapper with nginx, a server-side env-injection script, and a custom GitHub Actions workflow, making deploys **3x faster**.

Migrated the team's .NET microservice and React client to Kubernetes-based OpenShift, moving their Jenkins pipelines to GitHub Actions, then integrated the new architecture into **4 other React apps** across the division.
Raised unit test coverage from **80% to 95%** across four .NET microservices (NUnit, xUnit), alongside Jest and Playwright tests guarding portfolio workflows against regressions.
Ran on-call **production operations** across Agile sprints, investigating user-reported issues, analyzing logs, and applying targeted fixes to live portfolio systems.

description: Research internship under **Dr. M. Sridevi (Associate Professor, NIT Trichy CSE)**, part of ISRO Yukthi Sanchita, on 'Development of Computer Vision System for an AI Assistant.'
achievements: Designed a modular computer vision pipeline in Python (**PyTorch**, TensorFlow) running five models as independent **REST** services, behind a unified interface that swaps models without touching pipeline logic.

Cut per-frame latency by **90% (20s to 2s)** by turning sequential model loading into always-running REST services called concurrently, with **YOLO** person cropping so models process only detected regions.
